title: Map read-only Business Central UI look-and-feel for Universaarl prep
goal: Turn the existing Companies/Mandanten evidence into reusable UI rules for split-buttons, tooltips, lists, ListParts, filters and screenshot QA.
proved: Split-button targets must be separated into main button, dropdown arrow and menu entry.
Hover/tooltip or accessible-name capture is required before using ambiguous command-bar actions.
A visible new list row is not a saved company proof.
Screenshot QA must state page, company/context, important UI area, status and limits.
notProved: Company Creation can be completed with the current permissions.
Universaarl filter/report behavior with rich data.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: The catalog can now use the UI map.
Object coverage can be sharpened with split-button and screenshot-QA rules.
